rules.encoding: Strict UTF-8 without BOM; reject duplicate keys, invalid Unicode, unknown fields, signed floats, and booleans.
rules.canonicalization: RFC 8785; preserve Unicode without normalization; use the existing core/id v1 domains.
rules.binary_fields: Canonical unpadded Base64URL: Ed25519 key 32 bytes, signature 64 bytes, nonce and event_id 16 bytes.
rules.bundle_ids: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; supersedes is null or the same ID format.
rules.times: Nonnegative integer milliseconds; observed <= created < expires; lifetime <= 72 hours; created <= now + 5 minutes; expired when now >= expires.
rules.hops: Author cap 0..12; forwarding permission is evaluated separately.
